overview: What do you do when your furry best friend bites, barks and is a bully? We meet six desperate dog owners with dogs who have habits they cannot get a handle on. With the help of intensive training with dog trainer Maren Teien Rørvik, they will try to turn these rowdy dogs into good best friends.
title: Fra bølle til bestevenn

overview: De bachelorette is about romance, rivalry and, quite possibly, true love! Belgium's most eligible bachelorette, Elke Clijsters, is in search of the man of her dreams and hopefully her groom-to-be in this hit reality series. Our bachelorette is ready to find love and will embark on a romantic journey as she meets 20 handsome bachelors, all vying to win her heart. The guys compete for the bachelorette's affection via individual and group dates involving local and far-flung romantic encounters and adventures. As the bachelorette narrows the field and the number of men dwindles, romance and tensions will rise. At the end of her romantic voyage, if she has found Mr. Right, will there be a proposal — and from whom?
title: De bachelorette

overview: This time, the members of ATEEZ have turned into employees at an eccentric company, which goes by the name of 'ATEEZ Holdings'. The series will be called Salary Lupin ATEEZ, a play on a popular Korean slang term which refers to employees who are lackluster at work but who still take home their salaries on the dot.
title: Salary Lupin ATEEZ

overview: Gong Joon Soo (Im Joo Hwan) is a man who has had a rough life and early on had to fend for himself. He takes the blame for a murder his brother commits and serves time in prison. There he learns to sew and acquires a trade. After discharged from the prison, his newly acquired skills give him a job in a fashion company and works for Na Do Hee (Kang So Ra), the goody-good daughter of the fashion company which was built by her grandfather. Meanwhile, Gong Joon Soo's father was married to Jin Joo (Kang Byul)'s mother, both families learns how to understand each other and become a family even though they are not related by blood.
title: Ugly Alert

overview: The series will tell the story of a couple who, after 10 years of marriage, were locked in quarantine for 69 days in their own home. He is a successful pilot, she is a confident fitness trainer. Will these two leaders be able to pass all the tests of self-isolation?
title: 100 000 минут вместе

overview: Dexter Thomas reveals the untold stories of the video game industry and meets people changing how we play today.
title: Reset

overview: A young police officer loved a woman, promising to marry her. But the word given to the deceased boss connects his fate with the daughter of the deceased man. Duty obliges a guy to obey his conscience, and he marries a young lady, although he feels feelings for his beloved. A valiant policeman is obliged to forget about his love, so as not to destroy his forced marriage. A spouse has to live with a man whose heart is occupied with another woman. But the girl tries to get used to the flow of her new life and does everything to earn the respect of her husband. Past promises made to a beloved girl torment the soul of a policeman, but he could not do otherwise. Every day, the couple gets used to a new life, where there are no mutual feelings. But gradually, the wife falls in love with her own husband, and realizes that she is ready to earn his love, despite the rival who is deeply embedded in his heart. Soon the faithful begins to realize that the old feelings for the beloved begin to evaporate, and a strong attraction to his wife makes it clear,
title: Ghum Hai Kisi Ke Pyaar Mein

overview: They say people were couple created... Who Alara and Melek side by side saw, could have sworn the truth of this promise... These two young girls, they seemed to copy each other... The only thing that different was, was their destiny... Alara was born with a silver spoon in her mouth... she has everything you could imagine, except for the freedom... Melek had opened her eyes into poverty... She was beautiful, she was good hearted, she was hard-working, ambitious... Perhaps the only thing she needed, her unsmiling face's luck! "White Lie", the intersection of these two young girl's life ... the story of Alara's freedom, and Melek's story of a game that promises a chance to wait for life...
title: Beyaz Yalan

overview: The spin-off to the original series In aller Freundschaft focuses on the young doctors in a fictional clinic in Erfurt.
title: In aller Freundschaft – Die jungen Ärzte

overview: Kobayashi Haruka fell in love before finding out that her boyfriend was actually a married man. At that time, a regular customer predicts that she will wind up meeting 3 different men. She begins encountering them just as predicted. There's the hairdresser Shintaro, the band vocalist Yu, and the bartender Yoshi. What will come of these fateful encounters?
title: The 3Bs You Shouldn't Date

overview: Muppet Babies: Show and Tell is a short-form series featuring the Muppet characters from Disney Junior's Muppet Babies. Designed to promote the new Disney series and introduce the characters to audiences, the series premiered online with exclusive debuts of episodes on multiple websites on March 1, 2018 followed by a wider release online and airings on Disney Junior starting on March 2, 2018. In the shorts, viewers "get to know the Muppet Babies and their environment."
title: Muppet Babies: Show and Tell

overview: Santosh Mishra, an employee at the electricity division, leads a content life with his wife and sons. However, their everyday banter strengthens their relationship.
title: Gullak

overview: A satirical series verifying myths connected with Polish capitalism and the cult of "making money". The director, showing from behind the scenes the world of the native financial elite, portrays its ridicule, snobbishness and complexes. The name "the tiger of Europe", which is described by international media as Poland from time to time, is largely due to clever tax fraudsters, smugglers and various "bums". Over the last ten years, they have made not only jealous giant fortunes, but also their own model of culture and customs. A model that mercilessly exposed their intellectual poverty and primitivism. It is from this model that Gruza laughs first of all, proving that if the "Tigers of Europe" had been deprived of money, they would have been at most the wretched cats feeding on rubbish cans.
title: Tygrysy Europy

overview: Series in which mums and mums-to-be film their own stories for social media.
title: Bump Birth Baby

overview: Jae Hee, a diplomat in Prague, getting over a break-up meets police detective Sang Hyun and a romance blossoms. Jae Hee is the daughter of the Korean President and has to maintain a low profile. Jae Hee's ex, Young Woo and Sang Hyun's ex, Hye Joo make things complicated with secrets surrounding them. With the differences in social status, Jae Hee and Sang Hyun have to fight to see if the love that started in Prague can be overcome from what is trying to keep them apart.
title: Lovers in Prague

overview: Arriving at work at the convenience store to replace the salesperson, Joo Ah recognizes a guy she ran into on the street. He is very grateful to her, he needs to leave the store to get the prize. Joo Ah remains to work in the store and meets young guys, there are four of them. They are all with different personalities, cute, funny, charismatic, cocky and charming. Now Joo Ah has a job and she needs to work conscientiously to become a worthy employee, but what kind of work is there and how can she resist when four handsome men simultaneously show her attention.
title: Fling at Convenience Store

overview: Solos is a dramatic and thought-provoking anthology series that explores the deeper meaning of human connection, as explored through the lens of the individual.
title: Solos

overview: Extra Life: A Short History of Living Longer examines the science and medical innovations that conquered some of the world's deadliest diseases and doubled life expectancies for many across the globe.
title: Extra Life: A Short History of Living Longer

overview: All American: Homecoming follows a young tennis hopeful from Beverly Hills and an elite baseball player from Chicago as they contend with the high stakes of college sports, while also navigating the highs, lows and sexiness of unsupervised early adulthood at a prestigious Historically Black College.
title: All American: Homecoming

overview: Each installment of Travel Channel's Shock Docs goes to the heart of a true American horror story – and a peek into history. We travel across the country to uncover the best-documented paranormal encounters – tales recorded on video and audio that capture the raw terror of an encounter with evil. Additional Shock Docs on the slate for later this fall will delve into the true-life hauntings of the Amityville Horror House and The Exorcism of Roland Doe.
title: Shock Docs

overview: Your brother can't sleep, your neighbor drinks too much, your boss thinks she's great. Many of us have people in our lives who exhibit psychological peculiarities to a greater or lesser extent. But we rarely talk about it. Because we don't know how. In Psycho, people talk about what it's like to break up or to experience the world as an autistic person. And experts help us understand.
title: Psycho

overview: The action takes place in the provinces, in the seemingly quiet and idyllic town of Królowy Most, where CBŚ agents bring in gangster Jerzy Czapla, a crown witness in a trial against the mafia. As part of the witness's protection, his name and address were changed: now for the ignorant, Czapla, previously known under the pseudonym Żuraw, is called Bocian and lives in a villa rented to him. The details of the case are known only to the police commander, who, incidentally, is still struggling with many other problems: he lacks subordinates, although he has just been assigned to the Queen of the Bridge and cannot find a husband. for the daughter of Luśka, who has an illegitimate heir.
title: U Pana Boga w ogródku

overview: A mystery adventure series that features the mystery team's task to uncover suspicious events and secrets in a girls' high school.
title: Girls High School Investigation Class

overview: Millennials is centered on the lives of four 20-something roommates and their neighbors across the hall; as they navigate the chaos of being young and finding success, and themselves, in the city of angels.
title: Millennials

overview: Old grudges, new rivalries. A tangled web of murder and revenge spirals in a fractured Nottinghamshire mining community.
title: Sherwood

overview: Amend: The Fight for America explores the Fourteenth Amendment of the U.S. Constitution - which, in 1868, promised liberty and equal protection for all persons - as America's most enduring hallmark of democracy. Amend deploys a groundbreaking narrative format featuring a number of luminaries (Mahershala Ali, Diane Lane, Samuel L. Jackson, Pedro Pascal, Yara Shahidi, and more) breathing life into speeches and writings by the Fourteenth Amendment's most ardent advocates and foes (including Frederick Douglass, Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Ruth Bader Ginsburg, and Andrew Johnson) with insights from an inclusive array of contemporary thought leaders and experts. Executive produced and hosted by Oscar-nominated actor Will Smith and Emmy-winning writer Larry Wilmore, Amend is a powerful, multimedia journey through American history that encourages viewers to question what a "United States" really means.
title: Amend: The Fight for America

overview: Sandi Toksvig explores the UK's wildest, most remote and beautifully designed holiday homes, accompanied by some of the nation's most fascinating and funny women. From a lighthouse cottage on a private island near the Isle of Skye and a stunning tree house in the Wye Valley, to the only nature reserve in England in which you can stay, every episode visits a different region and promises hidden away places offering glorious sanctuary.
title: Extraordinary Escapes with Sandi Toksvig

overview: Remake of the radio series that was a part of the programme Take It from Here. The original parts were played by June Whitfield as Eth and 'Dick Bentley' as Ron. Jimmy Edwards reprises his role as the beer swilling father.
title: The Glums

overview: During the summer, Slysavarnarfélagið Landsbjörg sends a large number of people to the highlands of Iceland to take care of safety and provide assistance to tourists in the wilderness. We follow the teams around the clock and all the tasks that come their way. A unique opportunity to get an insight into the work of the rescue teams of Iceland.
title: Hálendisvaktin

overview: A documentary series about the 'CARMA' police district in Genk, Belgium.
title: Op Interventie

overview: Miniseries based on the autobiografy Un capitano (A Captain) written by Francesco Totti, former football player for AS Roma in Italian Serie A, in collaboration with Paolo Condò. The series follows the last 2 years of Totti's career before retirement.
title: Speravo de morì prima

overview: Siblings Leanne and Steve Ford help people move back to where they grew up. These houses have a lot of love and history in their walls, and Steve and Leanne's challenge is to respect their past while updating the homes for the new generation.
title: Home Again with the Fords

overview: Set in Detroit, the corporate executives of Payne Motors are at a crossroads: adapt to the changing times or be sent to the junkyard. Shaking things up is the new CEO, whose leadership, experience and savvy is only slightly offset by her complete lack of knowledge about cars. Luckily, her team has some of the best minds in the business - when they aren't fighting or trying to outwit each other. From the corporate office to the factory floor, the crew of Payne Motors is driving home the laughs.
title: American Auto

overview: Late 1980s. The journey of two brothers, Demetrius "Big Meech" Flenory and Terry "Southwest T" Flenory, having grown up with the street codes of Detroit. They gave birth to one of the most influential criminal families in the United States thanks to the drug trade.
title: BMF

overview: Showtime is developing the limited series Blackbird: Lena Horne and America, based on the life of incomparable entertainer and activist Lena Horne. Blackbird: Lena Horne and America will be executive produced by Horne's granddaughter, Jenny Lumet (Rachel Getting Married, Star Trek(R): Discovery), and Alex Kurtzman (Star Trek: Picard, The Comey Rule), who together will write the first few episodes. The series will be produced by CBS Television Studios and Secret Hideout. Heather Kadin will serve as an executive producer on this project. Titled after Horne's favorite poem Thirteen Ways of Looking at a Blackbird, Blackbird: Lena Horne and America will span 60 years of her life, from dancing at the Cotton Club when she was 16, through World War II and stardom of the MGM years, McCarthyism, the civil rights movement and her triumphant return to Broadway. The series will encompass her deepest relationships: Paul Robeson, Count Basie, Duke Ellington, Joe Louis, Billie Holiday, Hattie McDaniel, Ava Gardner and Orson Welles, to name a few. A direct descendant of slaves and their enslavers, Horne had to navigate stardom during Jim Crow. She laid herself down and made herself a bridge for everyone who came after her, and finally achieved her own liberation to become one of America's greatest legends.
title: Blackbird: Lena Horne and America

overview: Heartstopper tells the story of Nick and Charlie, two British teens at an all-boys grammar school. Charlie, a highly-strung, openly gay over-thinker, and Nick, a cheerful, soft-hearted rugby player, who one day are made to sit together.
title: Heartstopper

overview: We Are Lady Parts shows the highs and lows of the band – Lady Parts – as seen through the eyes of Amina Hussain – a geeky microbiology PhD student, who's on the lookout for love and is recruited to be their unlikely lead guitarist. Lady Parts' fierce and enigmatic frontwoman Saira sees something in Amina. However, the other members – taxi-driving drummer Ayesha, cartoon-drawing bassist and backing vocalist Bisma and the band's wheeler-dealer band manager Momtaz – are not convinced she is right for their band. Amina has never met girls like this before, and she's soon swept up in their joyful, anarchic energy and punk spirit. But she becomes torn and caught up between two different worlds – that of her more strait-laced university friends led by her bestie Noor and the world of Lady Parts. Will she be the key to the band's success? And – will she finally find a husband?
title: We Are Lady Parts

overview: Rap Sh!t follows two estranged high school friends from Miami, Shawna and Mia, who reunite to form a rap group.
title: Rap Sh!t

overview: Inspired by Kevin Durant's experiences, Swagger explores the world of youth basketball, and the players, their families and coaches who walk the fine line between dreams and ambition, and opportunism and corruption. Off the court, the show reveals what it's like to grow up in America.
title: Swagger

overview: After embarking on a life-changing field trip, a group of whip-smart students fight to save humanity from an army of ruthless drones.
title: The Last Bus

overview: Drama in which a frustrated Canadian detective who takes on a decades-old cold case in hopes of winning a confession and becoming a hero.
title: The Sting

overview: Across continents and decades, five brilliant friends make earth-shattering discoveries as the laws of science unravel and an existential threat emerges.
title: 3 Body Problem

overview: Chief Inspector Armand Gamache of the Sûreté du Québec and his team investigate a series of perplexing murders in the mysterious Eastern Townships village of Three Pines, uncovering the buried secrets of its eccentric residents and in the process forcing Gamache to confront buried secrets of his own.
title: Three Pines

overview: Comedy which revolves around a narcissistic woman with the "perfect" life, who is suddenly erased from the entire world's collective memory by a passing black hole that causes a rift in the fabric of reality.
title: Wiped Out

overview: Sally Lindsay is a house guest at upmarket homes around the UK, looking around the five-star residences and getting a taste of the owners' luxury lifestyles.
title: Sally Lindsay's Posh Sleepover

overview: A 12-episode online series about the funny and touching adventures of a student blogger who promotes the "child free" movement, but is forced to go to work as a volunteer nanny.
title: 33 Ребёнка

overview: The story is about two sisters with an incredibly complicated relationship. The younger Iris is a brilliant anarchist. She paints, writes songs, steals from stores, reads stand-up books, and doesn't give a damn about her older sister. The eldest, Rita , is an insecure employee of a glossy magazine who dreams of becoming a photographer. Through a clever manipulation, Iris deprives her older sister of her job and the abuser boyfriend, whom Rita held on to out of self-doubt. The older one is ready to kill the younger one for "breaking her life", but Iris comes up with a project in which both sisters will help girls who are dependent on their low self-esteem and do not accept "flaws" in their appearance. Phototherapy. Bodypositive. In this series, imbued with the current and progressive ideas of the "new feminism", two very different sisters will try to feel like a single whole in a project that aims to help other girls accept themselves. But will it help the siblings to accept each other?
title: Систер

overview: On their way to adulthood, the three outsiders Mark, Memo and Becky come into contact with a fantastic world called the Black Tower. There, the Gryphon, a world-devouring monster, has been mercilessly plundering and subjugating all living creatures for centuries. And the three friends, of all people, seem destined to end this reign of terror.
title: Der Greif

overview: Inspired by true events, the gangster epic Luden tells the rise of the Nutella Gang, the most famous pimp cartel in Hamburg's legendary Reeperbahn during the 1980s. The unusual cartel turns the rough red-light district in St. Pauli into a glamourous place, but it is also the beginning of a power struggle with the established pimps of the GMBH.
title: Luden – Könige der Reeperbahn

overview: Professional darts Eddie is in a crisis. Fame gone, money gone, wife gone and physical fitness also leaves much to be desired. With the help of his old buddy Nobbe, who is also a rusty dart professional, but with a strong tendency towards alcohol, Eddie wants to find his way back into life and his career and to prove that he was not called "the wasp" for nothing. Easier said than done. Before "the wasp" can stab reliably again, Eddie first has to take the path of self-knowledge and overcome some setbacks.
title: Die Wespe

overview: Click is shot in a screenlife format and shows the story of a specific online relationship between a student Yasha, a blogger Lisa and an adult IT specialist Arthur, accompanied by his eternally dissatisfied wife Sveta. The introduction of the main characters, shown in the first series, begins with mutual insults and ridicule, but very soon the three realize how much they really need each other. In each of the series, they will have to solve the "questions of life and death" of one of the team members: open a package from the darknet, pass a test, hide from his wife and pass other life quests. And often, solving one problem, friends will create new ones. Click was born as a result of the first web series accelerator conducted by TV-3 and 1-2-3 Production in 2019. The author of the idea of the series was creative producer Andrey Smiyan, screenwriters-Maxim Kozhaev and Alexander Bazaleev!
title: Клик

overview: The story is basically about a young women that wishes to become a cab driver. She soon find out that personal clerk in the cab company thinks that women is not fit to be a cab driver. But she doesn't quit there, she assumes a false identity of men. There is also a drug smuggling back story with $50,000 hidden in a Polski Fiat 125p cab. It's the last work of legendary polish director Stanislaw Bareja.
title: Zmiennicy

overview: In 2008, we were strong and full of passion! Back to the 2008 tells the youth growth romance stories of boys and girls of that time.
title: Back to the 2008

overview: Every 24 hours, millions of people post a video about their day on Instagram. We are used to seeing life as a series of successive stories. And we all want attention to our Stories. But there are people among us with real stories for whom our attention is vital. These are veterans and witnesses of the war, old people in nursing homes. They don't keep Stories, although they have a lot to tell. They can't attract attention in social networks, although it is attention that can improve and prolong their lives. Disappearing Stories is a series in the Instagram Stories format based on the lives of real people. Each story tells a small episode from the life of our heroes. Like Stories, it will simply disappear in 24 hours — just as the lives of veterans and old people in nursing homes fade away without attention.
title: Исчезающие истории

overview: "What are you going to play without me?" O$iris shouts as security forces push him off the stage of an important esports tournament. A year later, the former champion sleeps on the couch of a friend and fan of Nikita. To return to esports, he must assemble a team. And start from scratch.
title: Изи катка

overview: This is the story of two clubs of the International School – music and basketball, which, due to the uneven distribution of club funding, began their confrontation with each other. Min Lam, the head of the music club, and Hoang Dang, the head of the basketball club, challenged each other to find a team worthy of school funding. The music club will have to become basketball players fighting on the court, and the basketball club opposite will have to sing, dance and perform music. During a confrontation between the main characters of the enemies are converted into friends. But before the old conflict is resolved, a new one is born. Many questions arise: will they be able to overcome conflicts and barriers to love? What will two talented guys and their club members do to find a solution and live in harmony under the roof of the school?
title: Active Boys

overview: A dark film comic in the genre of noir. A retired detective meets a mysterious woman in a bar. After learning that she got into trouble with local bandits, the detective decides to help her.
title: Мизантроп

overview: The story is about real feelings, sex and loneliness in isolation, where the level of frankness that comes from a lack of tactility, communication and intimacy is reached. After a difficult breakup, Bai Lu went to Berlin for a couple of days, but was stuck there for several months. Dying of loneliness, she decides to take a desperate step - to find a guy without leaving the house. The quarantine caught her friends in Moscow by surprise - an abandoned bride, lack of money and experiments with a webcam, two children and endless work. Isolation will definitely change their lives, but in which direction?
title: Выйти нельзя остаться

overview: TS Madison sets out on a bold, unfiltered and authentic journey to be the first Black trans woman to host a mainstream talk show.
title: The TS Madison Experience

overview: Russia, 2020. A mysterious programmer creates a Mechanism-a neural network that performs the functions of a personal consultant. Every citizen facing social injustice or legal difficulties can receive the advice of the Mechanism. How the fate of the heroes will develop is up to you. Nina, the daughter of a rich official, returns from London to Moscow to rescue a young blogger friend who is accused of extremism. Here Nina is confronted with the realities of the new Russia, its state system — and the rapper Roman, a simple guy from the Moscow region, a sexist and chauvinist, who also fights for the truth, but with completely opposite methods. Nina and Roman fall in love at first sight — but will their feelings stand the test of the adult and harsh reality of modern Russia, and will they overcome the conflict in their views?
title: #КТО_ТЫ

overview: There are enough love and surprises in Maria's relationships. And no wonder she has a different man for each day of the week. Maria meets Juho and falls in love, but sadly there is no eighth day in a week.
title: Mister8

overview: Yoon Ji wants to get a part-time job at the manhwa cafe where our previous heroes worked. The boss immediately warns that he does not like office romances and must be able to separate personal and work, Yoon Ji agreed with this. But the girl did not expect to meet the guy of her dreams, whom they had already encountered once. What will happen next, watch Something Between Us.
title: Something Between Us

overview: Instant Mom is scripted half-hour comedy series that follows Stephanie, a former party girl who becomes a full-time stepmom to three kids when she marries the more traditional Charlie. Stephanie manages to keep it all together using her own unique style, never losing her sense of fun, and with the help of her mother Maggie, she learns what being a mom really means.
title: Instant Mom

overview: A story adapted from cases that depict how China's public security police cooperates with local authorities overseas to carry out law enforcement operations.
title: The Dragnet

overview: Paul, a young VTC driver who is lazy, pretentious, not very smart and leaning slightly on the bottle, welcomes in his vehicle people and personalities of all kinds. Never running out of ideas to converse with his customers and talk of everything but especially nothing, our driver inevitably messes things up. For example, he will not recognize certain personalities or confuse them with others. Funny and quirky situations for the best, and especially for laughter.
title: À votre service

overview: Eight abandoned dogs get a second chance when they are trained to become assistance dogs for people with physical and mental challenges.
title: Superhundene

overview: Explore the resurgence of iconic wildlife and natural processes across Europe's most breathtaking landscapes, from the Arctic Circle to rich river wetlands, from deep forests to rugged mountain peaks.
title: Europe's New Wild

overview: What is the world of internet fraud and who is behind it? Investigative journalist and filmmaker Anthony van der Meer, together with a small team of friends and his girlfriend, dives into the network of international scammers. Using their own methods against them, he tries to trick them and gives a unique insight into their practices, from phishing to dating fraud.
title: Bait

overview: The Serpent Queen is a period drama about Catherine de Medici, Renaissance Queen of France. Considered an immigrant, common and plain, Catherine de Medici is married into the 16th century French court as an orphaned teenager expected to bring a fortune in dowry and produce many heirs, only to discover that her husband is in love with an older woman, her dowry is unpaid and she's unable to conceive. Yet, only with her intelligence and determination, she manages to keep her marriage alive and masters the bloodsport that is the monarchy better than anyone else, ruling France for 50 years.
title: The Serpent Queen

overview: Modern day treasure hunter Drew Pritchard is one of the UK's top decorative antique dealers. Always on the hunt for that elusive gem, Drew travels the length and breadth of the country in search of weird and wonderful objects. The bigger the hoard of forgotten antiques and dusty furniture, the happier Drew is! And with a host of clients from all walks of life - from royalty to Hollywood stars, Drew's work is never done. Building on a childhood love of visiting car scrapyards to unearth rare and beautiful items, Drew has turned his lifelong passion into a thriving international business enterprise. Over 20 years of business, Drew and his specialist team of experts have restored an incredibly diverse range of items, from fireplaces, doors, lighting, gardern ornaments, to cars, paintings, jewellery and wooden artefacts.
title: Salvage Hunters

overview: The Thing About Pam is based on the 2011 murder of Betsy Faria that resulted in her husband Russ's conviction, but he insisted he did not kill her. His conviction was later overturned. This brutal crime set off a chain of events that would expose a diabolical scheme deeply involving Pam Hupp.
title: The Thing About Pam

overview: Azaan finds his soulmate in Shayra, but his mother, Begum Razia wants him to get married to her best friend's daughter, Noor. However, love triumphs against all odds in this battle - but not for too long.
title: Bahu Begum

overview: ‎When a horrific accident took his mother's life three years ago, Xi No (Fan Shi Chi Chi) was never able to fully recover from the shock. Since that day, Yu No has been living with an affective disorder so severe that he has lost all connection to his emotions. Unable to laugh, cry or even love, Xyu Noh is unable to communicate with other people, as he has lost all ability to empathize with others. Unable to feel guilty or remorseful, he has become a cruel boss when it comes to business. Despite the fact that he is known for his good work, his methods made him a target of several disgruntled people. ‎ ‎When the need for protection becomes apparent, Xi No begins to look for a bodyguard. Among the many applicants for this job is Ke Xi Yi (Qi Yan Di), an economics specialist who secretly dreams of becoming a professional fighter. With incredibly honed feelings and lightning-fast reflexes, Xi and easily copes with the task. ‎As the relationship between them grows, The long-lost emotions of Theo No gradually begin to return, and when they appear, a whole new world of possibilities emerges. But in this new world, Xi has to ask himself, is he capable of accepting the feelings he seems to have for Xi?‎
title: Love Unexpected

overview: The six-part comedy series follows the story of fictional veteran location scout, Steve Grogan, and his millennial off-sider Morgan, as they roam the Top End in search for the ultimate NT locations for the Top End Wedding movie.
title: Location Scouts

overview: After the final match of the Continental Advanced Soul Master Academy Elite Tournament, Tang San and his friends reluctantly bid each other farewell, promising to reunite in five years. They then set off on their separate life journeys. Tang San followed his father, Tang Hao, to a secluded valley for special training to further enhance his abilities. With Tang Hao's guidance, Tang San not only gained more experience but also grew more composed, allowing him to face greater challenges with maturity. Meanwhile, Dai Mubai and Zhu Zhuqing earned their families' recognition and became the Crown Prince and Princess-to-be of Star Luo. Xiao Ao and Ning Rongrong began rigorous training to increase their strength, and Ma Hongjun set out on a journey of learning to broaden his horizons. During this time, Bibi Dong from the Spirit Hall secretly plotted to dominate the Douluo Continent by sweeping away the major sects. In response, Tang San gathered his friends to establish the Tang Sect, committed to the pursuit of justice and determined to shoulder the heavy responsibility. They bravely ventured and growing together into indomitable warriors.
title: Douluo Continent

overview: Upon killing an old pawnbroker, a former student must confront the ensuing conflict between logic and emotion within him.
title: Преступление и наказание

overview: A criminal profiler finds a mysterious old phone that connects him to a clumsy yet resolute detective, who has been missing for 20 years and is calling from the year 1998.
title: Signal

overview: Off the Cuff explores the world's most unique, exciting, and often misrepresented communities.
title: Off the Cuff

overview: Jessica St. Clair ("Bridesmaids") and Lennon Parham ("Accidentally on Purpose") star as Jessica and Lennon, best friends who live on opposite sides of the country with the men in their lives. When Jessica is overnighted divorce papers, Lennon convinces her to return home to Brooklyn and back into the apartment they used to share. It doesn't take long for the girls to fall into old habits: movie marathons and late night girl talk sessions - none of which is good news for Lennon's live-in boyfriend, Joe (Luka Jones, Upright Citizens Brigade). Joe tries to be understanding but begins to feel like a stranger in his own home. Meanwhile, Jessica is trying to get used to her new single life. Will she have to start buying matching sets of underwear again? Also, reconnecting with old friends like Rav (Stephen Schneider, "Happy Endings"), who may or may not have feelings for her, is more complicated than she thought. All of Jessica's new efforts are met with the critique of the friends' precocious nine-year-old neighbor, Queenetta (Daija Owens), who is not shy about doling out advice on their life choices.
title: Best Friends Forever

overview: Allen v. Farrow goes behind decades of sensational headlines to reveal the private story of one of Hollywood's most notorious and public scandals: the accusation of sexual abuse against Woody Allen involving Dylan, his then seven-year-old daughter with Mia Farrow; their subsequent custody trial, the revelation of Allen's relationship with Farrow's daughter, Soon-Yi; and the controversial aftermath in the years that followed. Once celebrated for their on and off-screen partnership, Farrow and Allen's lives were irrevocably fractured and their sprawling family torn apart with the public disclosure of the abuse allegations and the vitriolic disputes that followed.
title: Allen v. Farrow

overview: Through intense duels, with unexpected challenges, Norwegian celebrities compete for who is the best in the World Cup exercises.
title: Kjendis-VM

overview: A child of love is not all forunt. For three years, Danish television has followed people who are fighting to become parents.
title: Når storken flyver forbi

overview: Host Geir Fredriksen helps Norwegians look for relatives, near and dear ones with whom they have lost contact, or in some way got away from over the years.
title: Sporløs

overview: Ever wanted answers after a break up? This show reunites ex-couples to ask some awkward questions. Some want an apology, others want closure - but could they get back together?
title: Eating with My Ex Celebrity Specials

overview: Dame Darcey Bussell swaps her pointe shoes for walking boots as she explores the stunning landscapes and beautiful islands off the west coast of Scotland.
title: Darcey Bussell's Wild Coasts of Scotland
